objective: Implement the audit logging service so create, update, merge, AI extract, import, export, finalize, and related state-changing events can be recorded consistently.
success_criteria: A shared audit logging service exists for critical record mutations.
Create, update, merge, AI extract, import, export, finalize, reopen, and archive events can be logged through explicit service methods.
Before and after states can be persisted in a JSON-safe form.
The implementation remains local-only and builds on the existing audit log repository.
stop_conditions: The task requires editing feature modules or database schema outside the allowed scope.
The task requires introducing remote logging, telemetry backends, or networked observability.
approval_gates: Adding remote logging or analytics behavior
Expanding scope beyond T3 audit logging service
notes: Ticket source: docs/implementation-tickets.md T3 Create audit logging service.
The service should wrap the existing audit log repository instead of bypassing it.
